args.description: leaps up with a rising cut of the greatsword above his head. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins
